steps.code:
# Import all remaining files
import os

results = []
for file_path in file_list:
    try:
        file_data = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=file_path, access_token=fs_token)
        content = file_data['content']
        basename = os.path.basename(file_path)
        title = basename[:-3]  # remove .md
        title = title.replace('_', ' ')
        result = apis.simple_note.create_note(title=title, content=content, access_token=sn_token)
        results.append((file_path, result))
        print(f"Created note for {basename}: {result}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error for {file_path}: {e}")
        results.append((file_path, None))

print(f"\nTotal processed: {len(results)}")
